21	func main() {
22		configPath := flag.String("config", "/etc/github-relay/config.json", "path to config file")
23		flag.Parse()
24	
25		logger := slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(os.Stdout, nil))
26		slog.SetDefault(logger)
27	
28		cfg, err := config.Load(*configPath)
29		if err != nil {
30			slog.Error("failed to load config", "error", err)
31			os.Exit(1)
32		}
33	
34		slog.Info("loaded config", "consumers", len(cfg.Consumers), "port", cfg.Port)
35	
36		mux := http.NewServeMux()
37		mux.HandleFunc("POST /hooks/github", webhookHandler(cfg))
38	
39		server := &http.Server{
40			Addr:         fmt.Sprintf(":%d", cfg.Port),
41			Handler:      mux,
42			ReadTimeout:  10 * time.Second,
43			WriteTimeout: 10 * time.Second,
44		}
45	
46		// Graceful shutdown
47		ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM, syscall.SIGINT)
48		defer stop()
49	
50		go func() {
51			slog.Info("starting server", "addr", server.Addr)
52			if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
53				slog.Error("server error", "error", err)
54				os.Exit(1)
55			}
56		}()
57	
58		<-ctx.Done()
59		slog.Info("shutting down")
60	
61		shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
62		defer cancel()
63	
64		if err := server.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil {
65			slog.Error("shutdown error", "error", err)
66		}
67	}

69	func webhookHandler(cfg *config.Config) http.HandlerFunc {
70		return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
71			event := r.Header.Get("X-GitHub-Event")
72			if event == "" {
73				http.Error(w, "missing X-GitHub-Event header", http.StatusBadRequest)
74				return
75			}
76	
77			delivery := r.Header.Get("X-GitHub-Delivery")
78	
79			body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
80			if err != nil {
81				slog.Error("failed to read body", "error", err)
82				http.Error(w, "failed to read body", http.StatusInternalServerError)
83				return
84			}
85	
86			// Validate signature
87			signature := r.Header.Get("X-Hub-Signature-256")
88			if err := webhook.ValidateSignature(body, signature, cfg.WebhookSecretFile); err != nil {
89				slog.Warn("signature validation failed", "error", err, "delivery", delivery)
90				http.Error(w, "invalid signature", http.StatusForbidden)
91				return
92			}
93	
94			// Parse payload for matching
95			var payload map[string]any
96			if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &payload); err != nil {
97				slog.Error("failed to parse payload", "error", err, "delivery", delivery)
98				http.Error(w, "invalid JSON payload", http.StatusBadRequest)
99				return
100			}
101	
102			repo := config.ExtractRepo(payload)
103			branch := config.ExtractBranch(event, payload)
104	
105			slog.Info("received webhook",
106				"event", event,
107				"delivery", delivery,
108				"repo", repo,
109				"branch", branch,
110			)
111	
112			// Match consumers
113			matched := config.Match(cfg.Consumers, repo, event, branch)
114			if len(matched) == 0 {
115				slog.Debug("no matching consumers", "event", event, "repo", repo)
116				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
117				return
118			}
119	
120			slog.Info("dispatching to consumers", "count", len(matched))
121	
122			// Dispatch to all matching consumers
123			for _, consumer := range matched {
124				if err := dispatch.Dispatch(r.Context(), consumer, body, event, delivery); err != nil {
125					// Log error but return 200 to GitHub to avoid retry storms
126					slog.Error("dispatch failed",
127						"consumer", consumer.Name,
128						"action", consumer.Action,
129						"error", err,
130					)
131				}
132			}
133	
134			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
135		}
136	}

Fix Tailscale Funnel path stripping causing 404 on webhook endpoint

Funnel with --set-path strips the path prefix before forwarding, so the
relay received 'POST /' instead of 'POST /hooks/github'. Mount Funnel
at / so the full request path passes through to the relay's own router.

Also fix ExecStop to only remove this port's funnel entry instead of
resetting all funnel config with 'funnel reset'.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
